title: Mahjong-Autotable squad lane map
description: Phase K Wave 8 — Vasquez (QA). Per-agent lane regex map consumed by tests/ci/check-cross-lane-bundling.sh. Each entry maps an agent identity to a single anchored ECMA-style regex; a path matches the lane when the regex matches the path. The script applies these in declaration order, then falls back to its legacy case-statement classifier for back-compat (so a missing lane-map.json never breaks CI). Maintain in sync with charters in .squad/agents/<agent>/charter.md.

wave_subdir_overrides.description: Files under src/backend/tests/*/Phase_K_W*/<AgentName>/ and Phase_K_W*/<AgentName>/ (anywhere) are attributed to <AgentName>, not Vasquez. This lets each agent author contract-style tests under their own subdirectory inside Vasquez's broader test lane. AgentName must match one of the lanes above (case-sensitive PascalCase: Bishop / Hicks / Apone / Vasquez).

shared.description: Paths classified as `shared` are NEVER cross-lane violations (used for repo-wide concerns).

shared_files.description: Phase K Wave 8 — Vasquez refinement (broadened in Waves 10 + 11). Specific files that legitimately span more than one lane (cross-pane contracts) and whose author may be ANY listed agent without that counting as an author-lane mismatch. The file is still classified to its PRIMARY owner (for cross-lane bundling detection — a SINGLE commit still must not span more than one lane), but the author-identity check accepts any of the listed authors. selectors_md_shared is the W7→W8 hand-off case. agent_handoff_protocol_md_shared (added in W10) recognises that docs/agent-handoff-protocol.md is co-authored by Vasquez (concurrent-agent safety + stash-discipline) and Apone (branch-protection runbook + lock-file relocation). shims_shared (added in W11) recognises that test shims in src/backend/tests/.../Shims/ are co-authored by any contract author so a forward-stage shim for a backend surface (Bishop) can land alongside Vasquez's contract harness without an author-lane mismatch. pwa_audit_workflow_shared (added in W11) recognises that PWA-related workflows (.github/workflows/pwa-audit.yml + .github/workflows/pwa-builder.yml) are co-authored by Hicks (frontend asset author) and Apone (workflow runtime owner) — primary is apone, who owns the .github/workflows/ namespace.
